description.en: Returns the player handle of a party member, found by parameter ID: it goes through the party list and returns the handle of the first member whose parameter ID matches. Other commands (CMND_GET_SOCCER_POSITION, CMND_SET_AVATAR_ENABLE, CMND_GET_AVATAR_LOCK_FLAG...) take this handle.

The player handle, or 0 if nobody in the party has that parameter ID.
null if the script system is not ready, no argument is given or the party data is not available.

examples.case: Checking a member's position (real usage, from ev42020800.nut)
examples.code:
local hdl = CMND_GET_PARTY_HANDLE("para_cp0001");
local isSangokuKeeper = CMND_GET_SOCCER_POSITION(hdl, true) == 1;
